CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_LNS] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter
AS(
-- Account PCC Code 1
SELECT
	 BLM.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BLG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
	,'Account PCC Code 1' AS ProfitCostCenterTypeId
	,BLG.FREE_TEXT_8 AS ProfitCostCenterId
	,BLG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BLG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BLGD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.LNS_GENACCTCLASS_DELTA BLGD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENACCTCLASS BLG ON BLG.ACID = BLGD.ACID AND BLG.BANK_ID = BLGD.BANK_ID AND  BLG.ISLATEST = '1'
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLM ON BLG.ACID = BLM.ACID AND BLG.ISLATEST = '1'

--UNION ALL

---- Account PCC Code 2
--SELECT
--	 BLM.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
--	,BLG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
--	,'Account PCC Code 2' AS ProfitCostCenterTypeId
--	,BLG.FREE_TEXT_10 AS ProfitCostCenterId
--	,BLG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
--	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
--	,0 AS TaskRunId
--	,0 AS WorkFlowId
--	,BLG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
--	,BLGD.RECORD_STATUS
--FROM BUSC.LNS_GENACCTCLASS_DELTA BLGD
--LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENACCTCLASS BLG ON BLG.ACID = BLGD.ACID AND BLG.BANK_ID = BLGD.BANK_ID AND  BLG.ISLATEST = '1'
--LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLM ON BLG.ACID = BLM.ACID AND BLG.ISLATEST = '1'

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter;

--CHECK IN THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
	CustomerAccountId
	,Timestamp
	,ProfitCostCenterTypeId
	,ProfitCostCenterId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
	CustomerAccountId
	,Timestamp
	,ProfitCostCenterTypeId
	,ProfitCostCenterId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,Timestamp = SRC.Timestamp
,ProfitCostCenterTypeId = SRC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId
,ProfitCostCenterId = SRC.ProfitCostCenterId
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
,TaskRunId= 0
,WorkFlowId = 0
,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId;

--INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter
(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[Timestamp]
,[ProfitCostCenterTypeId]
,[ProfitCostCenterId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[TaskRunId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[InsertDttm]
)

SELECT
CustomerAccountId
,Timestamp
,ProfitCostCenterTypeId
,ProfitCostCenterId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter_DELTA;

END
GO
